feature: Game-state conditions and values
description: Add conditions and values for alternative-cost and cast-zone checks, per-opponent land and hand comparisons, counters across all players, creature-type counts against each other player, distinct powers, Desert mana spent, cards discarded or drawn this turn, and Auras attached to enchanted creatures.

feature: Amounts produced by the previous effect or event
description: Add Values and references that read amounts and objects from earlier in the resolution or from the event: creatures destroyed or exiled, mill and discard counts, excess damage, the toughness of a triggering or sacrificed creature, the source of damage, the token just created, and the exiled card's mana value or type.

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Add target slots, selectors and counts that accept an announced X, a state-derived number or any number of objects, including mana value and power bounds taken from a Value, up-to-that-many targets, dynamic discard and mill counts, and tap or gain-control of several chosen targets.

feature: Ability cost forms
description: Add cost forms and mana forms: snow mana and snow spent, blight, non-mana additional-cost alternatives, dynamic unless-pays costs, repeated optional payments, X counter removal on mana abilities, tapping for waterbend and land-only discards.

feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player routing and chooser fields so effects can act on another player's library, hand, graveyard or permanents, let an opponent choose or split cards, make each player search or each opponent gain life, and gain control of attached or player-controlled permanents.

feature: Rule statics and permissions that do not exist yet
description: Add rule statics and permissions for blocking and attacking restrictions (blocked only by given powers or types, extra payments to block, tapped creatures blocking, attack or block only under a condition), reduced maximum hand size, doubled or altered combat damage assignment, untap-step skipping and mana spending restrictions.

feature: Missing keyword mechanics (suspend, buyback, myriad, madness, foretell)
description: Add keyword mechanics and grantable abilities the schema lacks: scavenge, menace and indestructible counters, fear and landwalk, champion, firebending, partner, echo, flanking, myriad, casualty and madness.

feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events and filters for becoming untapped, scrying, expending, voting, combat damage to a battle, combat or noncombat damage received, discarding this card, damage source reference, gaining or losing life once a turn, targeting by an instant or sorcery, and attacking a player but not a planeswalker.

feature: Replacement effects that do not exist yet
description: Add replacement effects for umbra armor, exile instead of dying, extra life gained, discard putting the card onto the battlefield, counter-removing damage prevention, life total damage caps, losing the game, stun counters and partial damage prevention.

feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Add selector and target kinds for producible mana types, what a spell targets, chosen planeswalker or land types, per-branch tapped restrictions, creatures that crewed, flashback cards, and enchanted-player controller forms.

feature: Random, guessed and hidden-information choices
description: Add voting, die rolls, coin flips by each player, guessed values and random sacrifice with repetition.

feature: Ability removal and base power/toughness overrides
description: Add continuous effects that make permanents creatures permanently or in bulk, grant triggered or activated abilities to each creature, and let a chosen object lose abilities while the source remains.

feature: Optional choices and if-you-do follow-ups
description: Add may-decline forms and follow-up effects gated on whether an optional action happened, including opponent optional exiles, search only if a counter was removed, else branches for declined returns, and reflexive triggers that target after the choice.

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add cast and play permissions from an opponent's hand, the library during a search, exile with extended durations, instants-only free casts and graveyard plays with an exile rider.

feature: Turn-history conditions
description: Add per-turn history conditions such as attacking this turn, descending, nonland permanents leaving or being warped, creatures dying under a given owner, and graveyard cards put there from the battlefield this turn.

feature: Modern keyword actions (venture, ring tempts, suspect, crime)
description: Add modern keyword actions: earthbend, incubate, venture, clash, and skipping your own turns.

feature: Copy and become-a-copy effects with added types or abilities
description: Add become-a-copy and token-copy forms that add subtypes, copy a chosen card with a granted ability, or let each controller copy their own tokens.

feature: Delayed end-step effects on created or returned objects
description: Add delayed triggers bound to a chosen or created object or timing: the cleanup step, damaged creatures, and a delayed cascade grant.

feature: Reveal/exile/mill-until loops with leftovers handling
description: Add reveal-until, look-at-top and search ops with a card type or variable count, a free cast or draw instead, and leftovers or two-pile splits handled as the card requires.

feature: Life gained or lost this turn
description: Add conditions and values that read the life you gained this turn, for intervening-if clauses and mill counts.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add counter and base-stat options for permanents returning from graveyard or hand, including two counters and +0/+1 or +1/+0 counter kinds.

feature: Life totals and game-result effects
description: Add effects that exchange or redistribute life totals between players.

feature: Stack, spell copy and spell-targeting effects
description: Add stack interaction that copies a spell once per legal target or counters the triggering spell without a target slot.

feature: one-off
description: Single cards with their own missing feature: bidding, text changing, divided counters, attach to player, extra upkeep steps, and others.
